GROUP.DESCRIPTION: Path for the data when none of the group conditions are satisfied.
GROUP.NAME: DEFAULT1

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(debits_origin='Y', OLD_BALANCE_ORIG - AMOUNT, IIF(TXN_TYPE='CASH_IN', OLD_BALANCE_ORIG + AMOUNT, NULL))
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: v_EXPECTED

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(ISNULL(TXN_ID), 'Null txn_id', IIF(ISNULL(AMOUNT) OR AMOUNT < 0, 'Null or negative amount', IIF(ISNULL(NAME_ORIG) OR ISNULL(NAME_DEST), 'Null account id', NULL)))
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: v_HARD

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(ISNULL(orig_sk), 'Origin account not in DIM_ACCOUNT', IIF(ISNULL(dest_sk), 'Dest account not in DIM_ACCOUNT', IIF(ISNULL(date_sk), 'Date not in DIM_DATE', IIF(ISNULL(txn_type_sk), 'Unknown transaction type', NULL))))
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: v_SOFT

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT t.txn_id, t.step, t.txn_type, t.amount, t.name_orig, t.old_balance_orig, t.new_balance_orig, t.name_dest, t.old_balance_dest, t.new_balance_dest, t.is_fraud, d.date_sk, tt.txn_type_sk, tt.debits_origin, o.account_sk AS orig_sk, de.account_sk AS dest_sk FROM stg_transactions t LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_sk = TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(DATE '2025-01-01' + FLOOR((t.step-1)/24), 'YYYYMMDD')) LEFT JOIN dim_transaction_type tt ON tt.txn_type_code = t.txn_type LEFT JOIN dim_account o ON o.account_id = t.name_orig LEFT JOIN dim_account de ON de.account_id = t.name_dest
